title: Deterministic Bytecode Comparison (V2.7)
description: Reference shape for scripts/compare_bytecode.py's output record (docs/decisiones.md D-057). This script NEVER makes a network call and NEVER modifies preprocess.py, score.py, registry.py, detectors/ or systemGraph. It compares source-compiled bytecode vs deployed runtime bytecode, constructor/deployed vs runtime, and proxy implementation source vs runtime. Verdicts are strictly MATCH, MISMATCH, UNAVAILABLE, INCOMPLETE, UNRESOLVED. MISMATCH is a technical fact, never an automatic vulnerability finding.

compareVersion.description: Version identifier of the bytecode comparison module (e.g. '2026.1').

address.description: Lowercase-normalized address of the primary analyzed contract, or null if unresolvable.

network.description: Network identification as chainId, canonical name, or network object.

verified.description: Whether the source code is verified. Evaluated by identity (is True), never bool()-coerced.

proxyComparisons.description: Per-proxy implementation comparisons derived from systemGraph.proxies[].

limitations.description: Technical limitations and non-MATCH comparison findings propagated for contextual AI interpretation.

note.description: Fixed legal/methodological disclaimer restating that non-MATCH verdicts are technical facts, never automatic findings.

rawInput.description: Extended V2.6.1 ingestion record consumed by compare_bytecode.py. Contains V2.6.1 fields plus optional bytecode and systemGraph fields.

network.description: Chain id, network name, or object.

businessRules: R-C1: Verdicts are strictly MATCH, MISMATCH, UNAVAILABLE, INCOMPLETE, UNRESOLVED. No other verdict codes are permitted.
R-C2: MISMATCH is never an automatic vulnerability finding or security signal; it is a technical fact recorded in comparisons and limitations.
R-C3: CBOR metadata stripping is deterministic, stdlib-only, requiring len >= 4, declared length > 0 and < len - 2, and fixmap marker 0xa0..0xb7.
R-C4: Constructor args separated via runtime prefix or elementary static ABI types; non-elementary types or missing data yield INCOMPLETE without guessing lengths.
R-C5: Proxy comparisons read systemGraph.proxies[]; unresolved proxies stay UNRESOLVED; proxy != implementation is not a mismatch by itself.
R-C6: Zero network/RPC calls; stdlib only; never modifies preprocess.py, score.py, registry.py, detectors/, or systemGraph.
